title: Unit Event — Light Up the Fire — Episode4 The End Of A Dream

meta.Episode: Episode4 — The End Of A Dream
meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD's explosive third event has roused expectations that the team might actually surpass RAD WEEKEND. That's when Taiga summons them for "an important conversation"...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: A customer just told me what happened.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You really went through with it?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
What did I say?
I didn't want to leave any loose ends.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I also told them about Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: They need to know if they're gonna “succeed” us.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
But I only told them a few things.
You'll have to tell them the rest... Right?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
I'm going home.
There's nothing left for me here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean by that...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I mean, didn't you see just now?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: There's no way we can do better than that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You aren't, are you...?
I thought you were willing to do whatever it took...!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: All I had to say was, “Taunt me all you want! I'll keep carrying his dreams!”

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I had no idea what to say in that moment. I drew a complete blank...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Goodbye.
This team was fun while it lasted...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I'm not gonna lie. This feels like the end of the line...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I... We never had a problem with losing to anyone.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Because we knew that we could fight again another day. At least, that's what we believed...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: There are actually people out there who can't be beaten no matter how hard you try...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Also, if...
Even if we manage to outdo Taiga someday...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I'm having a hard time seeing us surpassing RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I just don't know how we can...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I honestly didn't want to see things end like this...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: But I think it's time that I grew up and gave up on this dream...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
This...
This isn't fair! Not one bit...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Why?! Just why...?!
This was the first real dream I've ever had... Why did it have to be impossibly hard...?!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Why...?! Why...?!
Why couldn't I sing when it really mattered...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Why...?
Why am I such a stupid, spineless piece of garbage...?!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Did he mean we shouldn't chase after dreams we can't possibly achieve...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
I was holding you all back...
I knew this entire time...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: But I clung to how you guys were all chasing after the same dream as me...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
I didn't want to let go of that...
Which was probably really bad...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ken...?! What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I heard from one of my customers...and Taiga.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
He told you didn't he...?
About Nagi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You knew this whole time and didn't tell me...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why was I the only one who didn't know something this important?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
None of this makes any sense!
I thought everybody was on my side! We were all like family!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Seriously, why?! I don't get it! Why only me...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That doesn't explain anything at all!!!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Let's talk about this more at our place.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Including you, Akito, Toya, Kohane...
We'll need you all to join us.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Today, I'll tell you everything.
About how and why RAD WEEKEND happened...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I flipped the sign to say closed, so no one else should be bothering us.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: This is going to take some time, so please sit down and make yourselves comfortable.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Where do I begin?
I don't actually know exactly what Taiga told you all...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But Nagi is gone, and that's the truth.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm sure you all have a long list of questions you'd like to ask.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: So, please allow me to tell you everything, from the beginning to the end. Who Nagi was and how RAD WEEKEND came to be.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
And first...
Well, you need to know more about Nagi. About us, RADder.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: We first decided to form a team together when were in junior high.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Taiga and I went to the same school, but we didn't really get along at first. Him singing was the reason I actually began hanging out around here...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: One day, Ken walked by while I was doing a street performance... He gave me this look of boredom which really bothered me.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I thought, “Hey, don't ignore me! You know I'm here! Isn't there anything you feel passionate about?!”

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, I began singing like there was no tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: My performance definitely sparked something inside him. It was pretty obvious.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
We fought, sang, fought, sang...
Then, one day, this girl suddenly appeared, clinging to Taiga. That was when I met Nagi for the first time.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: She said, “You're the weirdo who's been hanging out with Taiga? Why don't you sing with me too?”

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: She sounded like a piece of work at first... But my impression of her completely changed after I heard her sing.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'd heard rumors that Taiga's little sister was an unbelievable singer... But I was still blown away.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yes. Despite her small stature, she had this mature singing voice and an uncanny ability to captivate her listeners...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: And before we knew it, the three of us began hanging out together.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Then, one day, Nagi said, “We should form a team. We could rule the world.”

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
As crazy as that sounded at the time...
Chasing after the same dream as the two of them sounded pretty nice.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: A part of me thought that we really could become the best musicians in the world someday.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: We went over to Crawl Green, the owner gave us his blessing to debut there, and we were given permission to put on an event.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: After that, scouts from the big labels began following us, and we ended up signing with an agency.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: We'd finally become professional musicians, but that was only the beginning of our troubles...
